prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate ONE transparent pixel-art idle sprite of Lupus Boreas / Andrius, Genshin Impact Wolf of the North, for a Maple-inspired side-scrolling 2D RPG lab. Primary reference is attached full render with dark navy mane; secondary illustration for markings only, do NOT copy its ground, attack effects, translucent giant wolf silhouette or white cutout artifacts. Normal blue-maned form, not all-white glowing phase. Face left in side/three-quarter view, calm alert standing with exactly FOUR long canine legs planted on a common baseline. Long narrow white muzzle, cyan eyes, pointed upright ears and enormous swept-back dark cobalt/navy spiky mane from head to shoulders. Slim white wolf body with pale cyan angular flowing motifs on flanks and long forelegs; dark blue claw tips. Dark cyan pointed wing-shaped decorations at upper forelegs, geometric blue crystal cuffs around rear ankles and small cyan diamond on each foreleg. A single long slender pale tail curves up from hindquarters at right into a loose curl, with blue edging and small ice crystals toward the base, not a broad furry fox tail. Preserve the long pale cyan ribbon-like mane extensions, ending in repeated small leaf-shaped motifs, sweeping gently back above body. Entire ears, mane tips, paws, tail and thin ribbons visible with generous transparent margins. Noble tall wolf proportions, not baby/chibi and not dragon. Mouth closed, no bite, running, howling or attack. No extra limbs, no ground ice, no snow particles, no aura, no floating orbs, no scenery, UI, lettering or shadow. Crisp square pixel clusters and clean navy outline, restrained 24-32 color aesthetic, readable at 180px high. Transparent exterior and spaces between limbs and ribbons. No painterly smoothing or noisy dithering.
